paper.title_en: Carroll limits of bosonic and supersymmetric D-branes in the Polyakov formulation
paper.abstract_en: We derive the magnetic and electric Carroll limits of bosonic and supersymmetric D-branes in the Polyakov formulation at fixed positive rescaled tension. Eliminating the nonsymmetric auxiliary tensor recovers the full Dirac--Born--Infeld action. On the regular domain with a positive-definite induced spatial metric and a positive lapse bounded away from zero, the auxiliary constraints remain second class in both limits. Eliminating them before or after contraction gives the same local reduced phase space. The magnetic Hamiltonian retains the full spatial determinant and the electric Hamiltonian retains the electric displacement squared. We compare their dynamics on flat D2 solutions and on curves in a common warped Carroll background. Both limits retain sixteen independent $κ$-symmetry parameters for flat Type II D2--D7 branes. The electric limit also retains a Neveu--Schwarz flux term in the fermionic constraint and supercharge matrices. Spatial T-duality commutes with both contractions on fixed-radius circle zero modes when the dual transverse canonical pair is rescaled in the electric case. The prescribed local Carroll--Weyl transformation fails to preserve the constraints, and both actions admit exact global dilations.
